baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins salatihim at word 4 to yuhafizun at word 5 under the construction ala salatihim.
baseline_models.mechanism: Prayer is presented as a charge held under active oversight: steady observance guards prescribed worship from omission, displacement, and erosion.

activation_trace.role: Prescribed worship supplies the concrete practice placed under guard.
Binding ritual prayer confirms the practice through the non-dominant side of the split mapping.
Preserving and guarding an entrusted thing makes the verb active custody rather than bare repetition.
Steady observance gives the custody a repeated temporal form.

changed_reading.after: They keep prescribed prayer as an entrusted practice under steady guard, preserving both its recurrence and integrity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The salat noun at word 4 can carry petition, praise, blessing, and mercy, while the guard verb at word 5 can carry retention against forgetting.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guarding prayer can mean keeping its invocatory and merciful content present in the self and in practice, not merely keeping an external appointment.

activation_trace.role: Supplication, praise, and mercy supply prayer's relational content.
Supplication, blessing, and mercy preserve that relational content across the split mapping.
Retention in the mind makes guarding resistance to inner disappearance and forgetting.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is an external ritual protected from omission.
changed_reading.after: They keep invocation, praise, blessing, and mercy alive in memory and enacted practice.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object salatihim at word 4 is governed by a guard verb whose inventory includes the protection of sanctity and covenant.
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction treats prayer as vulnerable sacred property or a covenantal charge whose boundaries can be compromised and therefore require alert defense.

activation_trace.role: Prescribed worship identifies the sacred object entrusted to the worshippers.
Keeping sanctity, covenant, and chastity frames prayer as a protected boundary and trust.
Watchful caution supplies the alert posture needed to prevent compromise.

changed_reading.before: They make sure their prayers happen.
changed_reading.after: They defend prayer as a vulnerable sacred trust, watching its boundaries as well as its schedule.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory's fire-contact branch becomes live beside the sequence in which the fire calls one who turns away, gathers, and containers what was gathered. Guarding salat can therefore mark a maintained countermotion that keeps retreat and hoarding from ripening into being claimed by that call.

activation_trace.role: Gathering dispersed things into one mass supplies the acquisitive accumulation in the danger sequence.
Roasting by heat materially activates the otherwise form-distant fire side of the focus salat inventory.
Calling and drawing by speech gives the fire an attracting claim on the described person.
Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the first vector of the countertrajectory.
Putting something into a container turns gathering into closed retention rather than circulation.
Encountering fire and its heat supplies the surprising focus-side contact point for the context sequence.
Watchful caution makes prayer a guard against entering the turn-away and hoard trajectory.

structural_cues: The feminine fire subject introduced at 70:15 continues into the call at 70:17, followed by the paired acts of gathering and enclosing at 70:18.
The focus later places active guarding directly on salat rather than describing an isolated performance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a fire/heat branch in the focus and a contextual chain of heat, calling, turning away, gathering, and enclosing. Reader arrow: guarded prayer interrupts that behavioral chain before it reaches fire-contact. Live alternative: the focus salat may activate only prescribed worship, leaving the fire branch as sound-shape resonance rather than mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Guarding prayer prevents missed ritual acts.
changed_reading.after: Guarding prayer is a sustained countermotion against withdrawal and closed accumulation, the trajectory contextually claimed by the fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: Beautiful restraint frames a diagnosis of sharp human oscillation: adversity cuts off patience and benefit closes the hand. Continuous prayer then supplies a repeated temporal practice through which active guarding can regulate both reflexes.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self back from panic supplies the regulatory action later stabilized through prayer.
Greedy panic and rapid disturbance supply the unstable baseline that prayer must reshape.
The cutting off of patience specifies the adverse-stimulus failure.
Withholding the hand from giving specifies the beneficial-stimulus failure.
Stillness and duration turn prayer into a stable cadence rather than a crisis response.
Steady observance makes guarding the maintenance layer of that regulating cadence.

structural_cues: 70:20 and 70:21 repeat the same touch construction with opposite stimuli and opposite failures.
The exception at 70:22 introduces those who pray, and 70:23 immediately marks their prayer by duration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: restraint, panic, broken patience, withholding, an exception for those who pray, and duration. Reader arrow: repeated guarded prayer trains a stable response across both loss and gain. Live alternative: the prayer clauses may identify a class without specifying psychological causation.

changed_reading.after: They maintain a cadence that absorbs both adverse and favorable shocks without collapsing into panic or withholding.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact prayer noun recurs at 70:23 and 70:34, but its predicates differ. Duration supplies uninterrupted recurrence; guarding supplies active custody, so the closing phrase adds preservation of conditions, limits, and integrity rather than merely repeating continuity.

activation_trace.role: Prescribed worship identifies the excepted group through the dominant mapped prayer branch.
Binding ritual prayer preserves the repeated object through the second mapped target.
Stillness and duration provide the first predicate's temporal axis.
The repeated prescribed worship anchors the second predicate to the same focus object.
Guarding and tending provide the closing predicate's custodial axis.

structural_cues: The same ala salatihim construction appears at 70:23 and 70:34, bracketing the intervening traits.
Only the final predicate changes, from duration to active guarding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: exact constructional repetition with two different predicates and branch images of duration and custody. Reader arrow: the second predicate adds an integrity dimension to the first's temporal dimension. Live alternative: the two predicates may be emphatic synonyms rather than a deliberate division of labor.

changed_reading.before: Yuhafizun restates that they pray continuously.
changed_reading.after: The two prayer clauses form a frame: daimun keeps prayer unbroken in time, while yuhafizun actively protects what happens within that continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prayer exception interrupts withholding and immediately opens into wealth bearing another's fixed claim. Guarding prayer's relational and covenantal content is therefore tested by whether possession remains open to the requester and the deprived.

activation_trace.role: Asking and requesting give the fixed claim an encountered recipient rather than leaving it abstract.
Withholding the hand supplies the closed economic reflex that the prayer-marked exception interrupts.
Acquiring and accumulating wealth supplies the held resource whose closure or circulation is at issue.
A binding due and fixed entitlement convert generosity into an obligation owed.
Deprivation and loss identify the second recipient pole even without an expressed request.
Prayer as supplication, praise, and mercy supplies relational content that can be preserved or contradicted socially.
Keeping covenant and sanctity makes economic openness a test of prayer's guarded integrity.

structural_cues: The exception for those who pray follows the gain-then-withhold clause and is followed by the fixed-right clause.
The recipient pair distinguishes voiced request from deprivation without request.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: withholding, prayer, accumulated wealth, an obligatory due, a requester, and a deprived person. Reader arrow: guarded prayer preserves an outward distributive channel that counters possessive closure. Live alternative: prayer and wealth-sharing may be coordinated traits with no causal arrow between them.

changed_reading.before: Prayer's integrity is measured within the ritual itself.
changed_reading.after: Prayer remains intact only when its mercy and covenantal posture do not coexist with a hand closed against another's fixed claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: Affirming the day of reckoning is paired with care mixed with fear and an explicit absence of security from punishment. The focus guard verb is thereby sharpened into wakeful moral vigilance rather than ritual complacency or presumed insurance.

activation_trace.role: Making a promise real in deed turns assent to the day into operative commitment.
Accounting and recompense supply the horizon before which prayer is guarded.
Care mixed with fear and caution supplies alert concern without despair.
Inner security and trust, explicitly negated in context, prevent prayer from becoming presumed immunity.
Watchful caution gives yuhafizun its non-complacent moral posture.

structural_cues: The repeated relative-clause pattern places reckoning, concern, and non-security in the same portrait later closed by guarded prayer.
The explicit negation of security blocks a simple ritual-guarantee reading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: enacted affirmation, reckoning, fearful care, non-security, and watchful guarding. Reader arrow: exposure to accountability motivates alert preservation of prayer. Live alternative: these can remain separate virtues, and non-security need not specify the quality of prayer itself.

changed_reading.before: Maintained prayer gives the worshipper a secure religious status.
changed_reading.after: They guard prayer precisely without treating it as insurance; accountability keeps its practice awake and morally exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same guard root first protects an exposed bodily boundary; seeking beyond the stated limit is named transgression, then trusts and covenant are watched over. The repeated guard on prayer closes this custody sequence, making prayer one entrusted boundary within a broader ethic of faithful keeping.

activation_trace.role: Protection of sanctity, covenant, and chastity makes the earlier bodily guard a direct custody analogue for prayer.
Crossing a limit through aggression supplies the failure that guarded boundaries prevent.
Exceeding the boundary and doing wrong names the resulting status of failed custody.
Security and trust supply what entrusted deposits are meant to preserve for others.
A preserved covenant that gives its party security supplies the durable obligation of custody.
Attending and monitoring an affair supplies the ongoing work required by a trust.
Binding ritual prayer becomes the final entrusted object in the sequence.
Keeping sanctity and covenant closes the sequence by applying its custody logic to prayer.

structural_cues: Verses 70:29-34 form consecutive relative clauses, with the same guard root at the first and last boundary-bearing items.
The beyond-that and transgressors construction explicitly inserts a limit before trusts, covenant, testimony, and prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: repeated guarding, an exposed bodily boundary, prohibited beyondness, transgression, trusts, covenant, and monitoring. Reader arrow: the sequence transfers one custody discipline across bodily, social, and ritual domains. Live alternative: the list may coordinate independent virtues without making them instances of one governing mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is a self-contained sacred routine.
changed_reading.after: Prayer is the closing entrusted boundary in a custody ethic that also protects vulnerability, limits, deposits, and covenant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding clause combines informed testimony with standing, care, and straightness. Its adjacency to guarded prayer makes prayer's custody compatible with public truth-bearing and upright responsibility rather than private withdrawal.

activation_trace.role: Making something clear from knowledge supplies the public truth content of the adjacent stance.
Care, preservation, and responsible charge connect standing by testimony to the focus's guarding action.
Straightness and balance give the public stance an upright ethical geometry.
Prescribed worship supplies the ritual practice placed beside public testimony.
Active preservation makes prayer a responsibility carried alongside standing for known truth.

structural_cues: The testimony and prayer clauses are adjacent and share the same relative-clause syntax.
The plural possessive forms make both testimony and prayer recurrent communal-accountability objects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: informed testimony, responsible standing, straightness, prescribed worship, and active preservation. Reader arrow: adjacency transfers public accountability into the quality of guarded prayer. Live alternative: the clauses may remain parallel virtues without semantic transfer.

changed_reading.before: Guarded prayer is chiefly a protected private relation.
changed_reading.after: Guarded prayer stands beside public truth-bearing: its custodian remains upright and answerable in shared life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Aimless play gives way to compulsive speed toward a conspicuous, potentially cultic target. After the focus's guarded prayer, this creates a negative ritual analogue: intensity and directed motion do not suffice unless prayer's object and purpose are themselves kept.

activation_trace.role: Action without a sound aim supplies the unguarded starting condition of the final movement.
Speed as the opposite of slowness supplies intense motion that can look disciplined while lacking guarded purpose.
An object erected upright and conspicuous supplies the visible destination of the rush.
An erected stone for worship or slaughter makes the destination a possible counterfeit ritual focus.
Prescribed worship supplies the genuine ritual object against which the rushed analogue is tested.
Guarding and tending shift the criterion from kinetic intensity to preserved purpose and object.

structural_cues: The final scene uses a simile of goal-directed rushing immediately after a command to leave the players until their appointed day.
The branchless final motion verb at 70:43 word 9 reinforces the rush structurally but is not branch-cited.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: purposeless play, rapid movement, an erected target with both marker and cultic branches, and guarded prescribed prayer. Reader arrow: the final scene exposes motion toward a ritual-looking target as a counterfeit of prayer when telos is unkept. Live alternative: the erected object may be only a race marker, so the contrast may concern compulsive speed rather than misdirected worship.

changed_reading.before: Guarding prayer means sustaining its visible performance.
changed_reading.after: Guarding prayer includes protecting its telos and object, because energetic, directed, ritual-looking motion can still be aimless or misdirected.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because qibalaka at 70:36 locates a crowd toward the addressee, while the cited q-b-l branch evokes prayer-direction. It remains anchored by the immediate post-focus contrast with guarded salat and by the crowd's eager approach. Render it only as a spatial activation: do not claim that qibalaka lexically means qibla or that every directed approach is worship.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The salat at 70:34 is actively guarded; 70:36-38 then presents directed, rushing aspiration without that custodial predicate.

activation_trace.role: Prescribed worship supplies the prayer whose orientation and integrity are under discussion.
Active guarding distinguishes durable custody from mere directional approach.
The direction toward which prayer turns makes the crowd's facing a form-distant analogue of ritual orientation.
Rushing forward supplies intensity and approach without evidence of guarded continuity.
The heart's eager hope supplies desire for entry that can be mistaken for qualification.

changed_reading.before: Directed eagerness toward a sacred center is evidence of devotion.
changed_reading.after: Direction and eagerness can imitate devotion; the focus distinguishes prayer by guarded continuity and integrity, not mere facing or crowd momentum.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the focus noun denotes prayer in its immediate form, not a second-place racer, and the road image belongs to a peripheral h-f-z usage. It remains doubly anchored in the two focus roots and is reactivated by the later language of not being outstripped and of speed. Render it as a process analogy for disciplined following, never as a lexical replacement for prayer.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines the salat inventory's close-follower image with the guard inventory's clear unbroken road.

activation_trace.role: The second racer following at the leader's rear flank supplies close tracking rather than autonomous sprinting.
The follower immediately behind the leader confirms the tracking image through the second mapped target.
A clear straight road whose trace does not break gives close following a continuous course to preserve.
Escaping beyond a pursuer activates the contrast between trying to outrun and remaining in disciplined relation.
Raw speed supplies the rival movement that lacks the focus model's guarded course.

changed_reading.before: Prayer consists of repeated stationary acts.
changed_reading.after: Prayer can be imaged as close, disciplined following along an unbroken course: fidelity is staying in relation, not winning by raw speed.

strongest_changes: The repeated prayer construction at 70:23 and 70:34 separates continuous duration from active custody of prayer's integrity.
The exception to panic and withholding turns guarded prayer into a stable regulator across both adversity and benefit.
The custody sequence in 70:29-34 makes prayer one entrusted boundary among bodily vulnerability, limits, deposits, and covenant.
The final rush toward an erected target makes guarding prayer's purpose and object as important as sustaining visible motion.
summary.what_was_special: The split salat inventory supported prescribed worship and mercy while also retaining fire-contact and race-following as contained activations; the h-f-z inventory supplied duration, vigilance, sanctity, custody, and an unbroken-road image. The context changed the focus from simple regularity into several coexisting mechanisms without forcing one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The repeated relative clauses may coordinate traits without making prayer causally regulate or unify them.
The fire, direction, race, and erected-target models may be analogical resonance rather than intended lexical force.
The exact division between daimun as duration and yuhafizun as integrity-guarding remains plausible but not grammatically compelled.
